top_signals.title: White House Braces for Democratic Investigations
top_signals.summary: Bully Pulpit International’s Adam Hodge and Monument Advocacy’s Mark Bednar are on Bloomberg This Weekend to examine the looming fight between congressional Democrats and the Trump administration over subpoenas, executive privilege and oversight of the White House’s relationships with corporate leaders. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, they also discuss congressional scrutiny of Nvidia, the fallout from the FAA ground stop and where Republicans and Democrats could find room for bipartisan cooperation in the new Congress. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
